title: Clean Stateless Kit Stores And Kit Command Requests
description: Implement stateless semio/js stores (KitStore, DesignStore, TypeStore facades) that only track task ids; single typed execute to semio/rs; extend Rust KitStoreHandle.execute so every call allocates a task id and emits lifecycle events; remove setField and any from public JS boundary; update semio/react hooks for taskId; extend existing tests.
summary: Added KitBackboneWireShim types (BackboneConfig, BackboneStatusDto, ConflictResolution, KitConflict) and stateless KitStore facade over SemioKitBridge with requestId lifecycle tracking, resolveSemioKitBridge, and createKitStore. Wired getOrAttachSemioKitBridge + executeSemioKitCommand + command engine to KitHostStore and __semioKitBridge. Migrated semio/react and semio/sketchpad to KitHostStore / KitHostStoreSnapshot; registry attaches bridge on __semioKitBridge; read-store getters accept bridge or facade. Restored useKitStoreSnapshot hook name after snapshot rename. JS (141) and React (11) embedded tests plus tsc pass for js, react, sketchpad.
